Context Data Version 1 Context Data Data Type Allowed Values SWComponent uint16 VerificationMode uint8 RECOVERY (0x00) MEASURED_BOOT (0x01) RUNTIME_PERIODIC (0x02) STRICT (0x03) ⌋ The SEV_EXEC_SW_COMPONENT_INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED security event contains the following context data: • SW Component: Defines for which SW component the integrity verification failed. The actual value is highly project specific and cannot be standardized in AU- TOSAR
